description: A Java class defining a client for managing device registration, credentials, and tenants via HTTP API calls within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes methods for CRUD operations on tenants, devices, and credentials, as well as convenience methods for setting up test scenarios.

classes.name: DeviceRegistryHttpClient
classes.description: A comprehensive Java client for interacting with the Eclipse Hono device registry over HTTP, managing tenants, devices, and credentials for testing purposes.

methods.name: addTenant
methods.description: Creates a new tenant with specified ID and payload, defaulting to HTTP 201 Created.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Retrieves tenant configuration information, expecting HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: updateTenant
methods.description: Updates tenant information with specified payload, expecting a specific success status.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Removes tenant configuration, expecting HTTP 204 No Content.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a new device under a tenant with default enabled status.

methods.name: getRegistrationInfo
methods.description: Fetches registration details for a specific device.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for a device.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves credentials of a specific type for a device.

methods.name: updateCredentials
methods.description: Updates credentials of a specific type for a device.

methods.name: updateCredentialsWithVersion
methods.description: Updates credentials with version control via ETag.

methods.name: addDeviceForTenant
methods.description: Creates tenant, registers a device, and adds password credentials.

methods.name: addDeviceToTenant
methods.description: Adds a device with password credentials to an existing tenant.

methods.name: addDeviceForTenant
methods.description: Creates tenant, registers a device, and adds client certificate credentials.

methods.name: addPskDeviceForTenant
methods.description: Creates tenant, registers a device, and adds PSK credentials.

methods.name: addPskDeviceToTenant
methods.description: Adds a PSK credential to an existing device.
